readme.excerpt:
vAPI Network builds payment and trust infrastructure for AI agents on Base, with x402 API payments in USDC.

One wallet, every x402 API. vapi-network is its open-source, non-custodial TypeScript client for discovering and paying x402 services from a terminal, an MCP client, or your own code. The device vault encrypts your keys on this machine, using an OS-stored device key with optional password protection. vAPI applies spend policy before signing, sends the payment straight to the service, and writes a local receipt. Local runs keep keys on this machine; experimental Railway runs require explicit member-key export. Every payment identifies this client as vapi through x402 builder-code ; when an API advertises payment-identifier , the generated id is kept on that receipt.

vAPI Call takes no fee. Providers are paid directly.

readme.excerpt:
A fast, native database client for PostgreSQL , MySQL , SQLite and BigQuery . Written in Rust with egui; runs on Linux (Omarchy and Hyprland first), macOS and Windows. BigQuery connections sign in with a service-account key file or Google Cloud's default credentials, and open read-only (browse, filter and run SELECTs; BigQuery has no transactions to edit rows with).

The guide and the reference are on the website: igor.works/tabletist .

- Saved connections grouped in a picker, each tagged with its environment (dev, staging, production) and when it was last used. Open more than one and each is a chip in the window's header: click one to switch. - Direct connections, TLS (libpq's sslmode values, with allow read as prefer ; verify-ca needs a CA file, and MySQL has no verify-ca yet), and SSH tunnels (password, key file or agent) with host keys trusted on first use. The agent is the one ~/.ssh/config names for the host ( IdentityAgent , as for 1Password), else SSH AUTH SOCK . - Passwords live in the system keyring, or are asked for once per connection tab (reconnecting in that tab reuses them). - A connection opens read-only when its "Open read-only" box says so, which is the default for production. A writable one opens a read-write session, in which browsing, a raw WHERE and a SQL editor switched to Read-only still only read. - On a writable connection a table's values are edited in its grid: changes stay pending until Save writes them in one transaction, which never overwrites

items.name: fabric-pipeline-express-7
items.description: Event-driven OneLake pipeline with automated Upsert merge and Python reporting

readme.excerpt:
fabric-pipeline-express-7 implémente un pipeline Microsoft Fabric Data Factory entièrement événementiel : dès qu'un fichier de suivi de colis est déposé dans OneLake, le pipeline se déclenche automatiquement sans intervention manuelle. Il fusionne les enregistrements reçus dans une table Delta via une opération Upsert sur la clé shipment id, garantissant qu'aucune ligne n'est dupliquée, même lorsqu'un fichier est rejoué. Une fonction Python hébergée dans Fabric analyse ensuite le nom du fichier et le volume de lignes traitées pour rédiger un compte rendu de vague, qui est publié dans Microsoft Teams. Le projet repose sur quatre activités — Set variable, Copy data, Functions et Microsoft Teams — orchestrées par un déclencheur OneLake, et inclut le code de la fonction, les expressions du pipeline et un guide PDF détaillant chaque étape.

- Windows 10 or Windows 11 - PowerShell 5.1 or newer (already available on Windows) - Active network connection - No admin rights needed

- Event-driven orchestration : A trigger bound to OneLake file-created events watches the designated inbox folder and launches the pipeline automatically the moment a matching file lands. No scheduler, no manual run, no polling loop; the arrival of data is itself the execution signal.

- 零外部依赖 ：Spring Boot 单体 + Thymeleaf 服务端渲染 + Quartz + H2 内嵌元数据库，内网离线可用。 - 全量不是批量查询导入 ：主键 keyset 分块、单表内并行、结果集流式读取、逐块提交与检查点，单表吞吐可达 20 万行/秒量级 。 - 增量只有一条索引查询 ：默认轮询模式只读游标之后的变化，一个只读账号即可；六类源库可切换日志 CDC，做到秒级延迟。 - 结构与数据一起走 ：目标库缺失时自动建表 / 索引 / 视图 / 存储过程，内置各方言类型映射与函数转换。 - 可靠续传 ：停机、断网、进程被杀都能从检查点继续，写入全部幂等，停机期间源库的变更重启后自动补齐。 - 另有专属迁移 ：三条不走 JDBC 的整库复制链路，使用独立的连接模型，与实时同步、ETL 互不影响。 - 出了问题会通知你 ：同步失败、CDC 停摆、数据漂移等七类故障可推送到钉钉、企业微信、飞书或自定义 Webhook。

政企系统从 MySQL、Oracle、SQL Server 迁移到达梦、金仓、OceanBase 等国产数据库时，迁移往往不是一次性搬完：新旧系统双轨运行、分批割接、历史库只读共存，都要求两个库在数周甚至数月里 持续保持一致 。

items.name: fd
items.description: A simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to 'find'

readme.excerpt:
fd is a program to find entries in your filesystem. It is a simple, fast and user-friendly alternative to find . While it does not aim to support all of find 's powerful functionality, it provides sensible (opinionated) defaults for a majority of use cases.

Intuitive syntax: fd PATTERN instead of find -iname ' PATTERN ' . Regular expression (default) and glob-based patterns. Very fast due to parallelized directory traversal. Uses colors to highlight different file types (same as ls ). Supports parallel command execution Smart case: the search is case-insensitive by default. It switches to case-sensitive if the pattern contains an uppercase character\ . Ignores hidden directories and files, by default. Ignores patterns from your .gitignore , by default. The command name is 50% shorter\ than find :-).

First, to get an overview of all available command line options, you can either run fd -h for a concise help message or fd --help for a more detailed version.

items.description: ripgrep recursively searches directories for a regex pattern while respecting your gitignore

readme.excerpt:
ripgrep (rg) ------------ ripgrep is a line-oriented search tool that recursively searches the current directory for a regex pattern. By default, ripgrep will respect gitignore rules and automatically skip hidden files/directories and binary files. (To disable all automatic filtering by default, use rg -uuu .) ripgrep has first class support on Windows, macOS and Linux, with binary downloads available for every release. ripgrep is similar to other popular search tools like The Silver Searcher, ack and grep.

Installation User Guide Frequently Asked Questions Regex syntax Configuration files Shell completions Building Translations
